title: A layer can be flipped horizontally or vertically
goal: A person can flip what is picked left to right or top to bottom the way Photoshop and Figma let them: from the right-click menu, from the menu bar, and by dragging a side handle past the opposite side. Today there is no way at all.
notes:
The user, 2026-10-20: 'there's no way to flip a layer. I tried resizing it and dragging to reverse it but that didn't work. no right click to reverse horiz/vert either.'

The model and renderer already carry it: LayerTransform.flipHorizontal and flipVertical (Sources/PhotonzCore/LayerTransform.swift:14, applied in affineTransform at :33), drawn by DocumentRenderer.swift:2845, exported as an SVG matrix (SVGExport.swift:1935-1943). The only thing that sets them today is Mirror Across Center (MirrorAcrossCenter.swift, behind its own switch, which makes a mirrored COPY, not a flip). So this is mostly a missing command and a handle drag that clamps at zero; NOT confirmed by running the app, reproduce first. Check that a resize past zero turns into a flip of the transform, not a negative frame (frames stay standardized). Check the video path draws the flip during playback and export.
acceptance: Reproduce first at Next defaults: pick a layer, right-click, look in the menu bar, and drag a side handle past the opposite edge; record what happens as the before

Flip Horizontal and Flip Vertical are in the picked layer's right-click menu (under a Transform group if it has one) and in the menu bar where Photoshop keeps them (Edit > Transform), with Photoshop's shortcuts if it has any and none invented where it has none (UX-PATTERNS section 7)
Dragging a side or corner handle past the opposite side flips the layer and keeps going, as in Photoshop and Figma, instead of stopping at zero width

Works for every kind of layer that can be picked (picture, shape, path, text, group, component copy, several picked at once around their shared middle) on a picture and on a video, each flip one undo step; text reads mirrored, which is what a flip means
A flipped layer looks the same on the canvas, in a PNG, in an SVG and in an MP4, measured by comparing the renders
An agent can flip too (a command by name and through set_layer), so Ask can mirror a drawing's second half

A walk per way in, and an audit under queue/audits/ with before and after pictures. Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not

log.note: Before, reproduced at Next defaults on the probe (walk /tmp/flip-before/flip-before-walk.json): the rectangle's right-click menu has Duplicate, Mirror Across Center... no Flip row; Edit menu has no Transform submenu; Layer menu has none either; dragging the right handle from (600,375) to (300,375) left the rectangle at frame (400, 300, 1.0, 150): Handles.resize clamps at minSize 1.

Adversarial pass before building: Photoshop keeps Flip Horizontal / Flip Vertical in Edit > Transform with NO default keys, so none here (Figma's Shift H / Shift V are not Photoshop's; UX-PATTERNS 7). A flip of a rotated layer is a canvas-space mirror (rotation and skew negate), as Photoshop does. Several picked flip about their shared middle. A handle drag flips in the layer's own box (Photoshop free transform), so a rotated layer stays rotated. Moving layers on a video: chose mirroring the look at every moment (rotation keys negated, position keys shifted only when several move about a shared middle) over mirroring the path it travels, because Flip is about how it looks, as Premiere's Horizontal Flip effect. 3D turns left alone.
owns these walks: flip-a-layer-walk, flip-by-dragging-a-handle-walk, flip-a-title-on-a-video-walk

Built: PhotonzCore/LayerFlip.swift (FlipAxis, Layer.reflected(across:at:) generalising Mirror Across Center's left-right reflect to both axes, Layer.flipped (rotation keys negated, position keys shifted with the box), Layer.mirroredInPlace for the handle drag, PhotonzDocument.canFlip/flip (one about its own middle, several about their shared middle, one undo step), Handles.resizeFlipping/crossings/anchoredFrame(flips:)). App: EditorState+Flip.swift, Edit > Transform submenu in EditorCommands, right-click rows in LayerCommandMenu under Send to Back, CanvasResizeFlip.swift + ResizeDrag.flips threaded through resizedFrame/onFlippedFramePreview/Commit. Agent: run_command flip_horizontal / flip_vertical, set_layer flip (horizontal|vertical|both), read_document reports flipped. Switch next-flip-layers, on by default in Next only.

Chose flat right-click rows (Figma) over a Transform submenu because the menu has no Transform group and one click beats two. Chose no keys because Photoshop gives Edit > Transform > Flip none (UX-PATTERNS 7); Figma's Shift H / Shift V would be invented here.

Verified: LayerFlipTests (21), FlippedLayerRenderTests (canvas equals the mirrored render, SVG read back equals the canvas for a photo, words and an arrow), FlippedLayerExportTests (a real MP4 reads blue left / red right after a horizontal flip), AgentDrawingTests set_layer flip; full Scripts/test.sh green, 14179 tests. Walks green on the probe at Next defaults: flip-a-layer-walk (right-click, Edit > Transform, undo, words), flip-by-dragging-a-handle-walk (picture right handle 200 past left -> (350,350,200,700) flipped H; bottom handle past top -> flipped both; undo; words), flip-a-title-on-a-video-walk. agent-commands-drill flip: both one undo step. set_layer flip checked through the MCP bridge. Existing mirror, right-click, resize and handle walks rerun green.

Pictures looked at: before right-click (no Flip row), before drag (1pt wide), after right-click menu (Flip Horizontal / Flip Vertical under Send to Back), words mirrored, picture mid drag mirrored dark half on the right, title on the video mirrored a second later.

left rough (did not clear the follow-up bar, nobody stopped by it): magnets off while a drag is past the other side; flipped drag re-renders per move instead of floating a sprite; words flip about their stored box so slack shifts them ~2pt; 3D turns not mirrored; Ask was not re-measured on the eval since no prompt or drawing changed (only the set_layer tool description gained flip).

Flip Horizontal / Flip Vertical in Edit > Transform and on the right-click menu, a handle dragged past the other side flips and keeps going, agents via run_command and set_layer flip. Next only (next-flip-layers, default on). Verified by unit + canvas/SVG/MP4 render tests, full suite green (14179), three walks at Next defaults, agent drill.
